description: This file is a shell script for testing git blame encoding conversion behavior with various character encodings such as UTF-8, EUC-JP, and SJIS. It sets up a git repository, commits changes with different encodings, and verifies that blame output respects encoding settings.

methods.name: filter_author_summary
methods.description: Filters and extracts 'author' and 'summary' lines from the output of git blame for comparison in tests.
